title: Console Starter Wizard — Empty State Illustrations & Contextual Tips
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a compact, brand-aligned set of empty-state illustrations, contextual tip microcopy, and first-run checklist art assets for the Console Starter Wizard. Goal is to reduce time-to-first-success (TTFS) for new users by providing clear next steps, progressive disclosure for advanced options, and accessible visuals that scale between desktop and tablet. Deliverables include static SVGs and microanimation specs, copy variants for primary/secondary CTA flows, and a screenshot checklist for PM/Eng to capture final UI across locales.
acceptance_criteria: Set of 6 unique empty-state illustrations exported as SVG + 2x PNG with naming convention DES-42109_empty_<name>_v1
Microcopy pack: primary CTA, secondary CTA, skip link, tooltips (EN + ES), and one expansion example for localization
Vector assets pass WCAG 2.1 contrast target for foreground elements when placed on card backgrounds
Handoff artifact in Figma with export slices and CSS token annotations; engineering sign-off on asset sizes and responsive breakpoints
Screenshot capture guide (desktop 1440px, tablet 1024px) and checklist added to this ticket's attachments
visual_specs: Art direction: friendly, geometric shapes with softened corners; single accent illustration color + neutral grayscale
Illustration grid: 320x240 artboard for small components, 640x480 for hero/stage illustrations
Micro-animations: subtle float + opacity on load (timeline 450ms ease-out), exported as Lottie JSON for progressive enhancement
Typography: Inter Variable for headings (600), Inter Regular for body (16px line-height 24px)
Padding & spacing: card inner padding 20px, illustration margin-bottom 16px, CTA stack gap 12px
screenshots_needed: Welcome step with empty project list (desktop 1440x900)
First-run checklist expanded with tooltips visible (desktop 1440x900)
Empty model catalog with filter hint (tablet 1024x768)
notes_for_engineering: Provide a lightweight Lottie player wrapper that falls back to SVG on older browsers
Expose CSS tokens for illustration accent and background so assets can adapt to theme changes
Use responsive img srcset for PNG fallbacks: 1x and 2x
Add data-testids to checklist items: data-testid=wizard-checklist-item-{step}
accessibility_considerations: All text overlays on illustrations must meet 4.5:1 contrast
Animations should respect prefers-reduced-motion and pause after first loop
Illustrations include descriptive aria-labels and decorative=true where appropriate
Keyboard focus order validated for checklist expand/collapse controls
copy_variants: Primary CTA: 'Create sample project' | 'Start guided tour'
Skip flow: 'Skip for now — I'll explore later' (secondary tone)
Tooltip short tip: 'Use the guided tour to provision capacity in minutes'
Tooltip long tip (on hover): 'Can’t decide? Start with a demo project to preview latency and cost estimates.'

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Animated Lottie files may increase bundle size. Mitigation: lazy-load animations and provide static SVG fallbacks.
Risk: Localization causes copy length overflow in small cards. Mitigation: provide truncation rules and shortened variants for ES/FR.
Risk: Illustrations clash with custom tenant themes. Mitigation: use single accent token and neutral backgrounds to reduce conflict.
